title: Business case automasi Perusahaan Simulasi C
notice: Seluruh angka dan keputusan adalah simulasi orisinal. Tidak menyatakan return yang akan dicapai perusahaan nyata.
perspective: Incremental project cash flow before tax and financing
discount_basis: Synthetic annual nominal pre-tax hurdle 10%; not an asserted market WACC or universal rate
baseline: Do nothing incremental cashflows are zero; no existing-business cashflows or sunk cost included.
timing: Cashflow is recognized exactly at the listed dates. XNPV/XIRR use actual days divided by 365. Annual NPV/IRR is displayed separately for comparison. No intrayear interpolation is claimed as observed cash.
scope_notes: No tax, depreciation tax shield, financing flow or going-concern terminal value is modeled
Disposal and working-capital recovery are explicit uncertain assumptions
Initial and maintenance capex share capex multiplier; implementation cost, working capital and disposal proceeds remain unchanged in these sensitivities

decision.ask: Approve the base investment subject to contract validation, cash-benefit verification, and reapproval if the cost ceiling or downside limits are breached
release_conditions: Signed supplier quote within the approved cost envelope
Operations validates benefit ramp without double counting
CFO validates liquidity and confirms the pre-tax model is appropriate
Reapproval required for a negative combined-downside NPV or initial funding above the ceiling
decision.fallback: Do not commit full funding while a release condition remains unresolved
